description: South Korea overtime, night and holiday work premiums under the Labor Standards Act (1.5x overtime, +0.5x night, 1.5x/2x holiday); workplaces with fewer than 5 employees get no premium.

fiveOrMoreEmployees.description: Workplace has 5 or more employees; default true

holidayHours.description: Holiday work hours up to 8 per day

holidayHoursOver8.description: Holiday work hours beyond 8 per day

nightHours.description: Night hours (22:00-06:00); also enter them as overtime if they overlap

unit.description: hourly, or monthly (divided by 209 hours); default hourly

wage.description: Hourly wage, or monthly ordinary wage when unit is monthly (KRW)

name: overtime_pay
